download_realunify_dataset: download the RealUnify GEU dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts and images to a local directory
download_realunify_force: force re-download the RealUnify GEU dataset even if it already exists in the data directory
load_prompts_from_realunify: load all RealUnify GEU prompts from a downloaded dataset into a lookup dictionary by id
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it processes GEU_direct.json and downloads images
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function to understand how it reads prompts.jsonl and builds a lookup dictionary
